description: This file implements a React component for an Event Logging page in a frontend application, allowing users to view, filter, and create new event log entries related to production, downtime, and quality events. It includes UI components, state management, API calls, and form handling.

classes.name: TabButton
classes.description: A button component for switching between different event categories (Production, Downtime, Quality), styled based on active state.

classes.name: EventForm
classes.description: A form component for creating new event log entries, with fields depending on the event type.

methods.name: EventsPage
methods.description: Main React component managing event log display, filtering, and creation modal.
